content: {"paper_id":"lab-8238ab546031","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","exact_quote":"we first formulate a convex semisupervised low-dimensional embedding model by incorporating a new dissimilarity regularizer into GLPCA (i.e., an unsupervised dimensionality reduction model)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确构建凸半监督低维嵌入模型，并将新不相似正则项融入GLPCA这一无监督降维模型，符合显式低维映射与维度压缩目标。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"the dissimilarity propagation-guided graph-Laplacian principal component analysis (DP-GLPCA)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"模型明确基于图拉普拉斯主成分分析，即用图拉普拉斯结构对主成分/低维嵌入学习施加几何一致性约束。"},{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","exact_quote":"we innovatively propose to propagate the cannot-link constraints (i.e., dissimilarity) to refine the dissimilarity regularizer to be more informative.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要说明只传播cannot-link（不相似）成对约束以细化不相似正则项，符合仅传播不相似关系的成对约束传播定义。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"convex semisupervised low-dimensional embedding model","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确构建半监督低维嵌入模型，使用有限成对约束指导全部样本学习，符合半监督学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"By fully utilizing a limited number of weakly supervisory information in the form of pairwise constraints","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"使用有限成对约束作为弱监督信息替代完整实例级标签，并将该监督条件作为约束聚类模型的核心研究问题。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","reason_zh":"标题与摘要出现GLPCA/PCA和低维嵌入，但未明确低秩约束、分解或近似表示，无法确认满足低秩建模定义。"}],"input_issues":[]}
